purpose: Incremental architecture-analysis cache. Accelerates future HYDRA architecture work by recording the exact repository state (commit + working-tree changes) the cache was last synchronized against, so a future pass can diff from HERE instead of re-reading the whole repository or trusting a SHA hard-coded in old conversation history. The cache is NOT an authoritative specification -- the portal content files (hydra-model-*.js, hydra-architecture-data.js) and the HYDRA source tree remain the source of truth.
howToUseThisFile: Always resolve the CURRENT state dynamically (git rev-parse HEAD, git status) before trusting anything below. Compare it against analyzedState.head.sha and analyzedState.workingTree here. If they match exactly, the cache is current as-is. If HEAD advanced, diff analyzedState.head.sha..HEAD for the aggregate changed-file set (don't walk intermediate commits one by one unless needed). If the working tree is dirty, also fold in staged/unstaged/untracked relevant paths. Never assume an older SHA quoted elsewhere (chat history, a stale README) is still current -- this file is the only source of truth for 'what was last checked'.

analyzedState.resolvedDynamicallyVia: git rev-parse HEAD / --abbrev-ref HEAD; git diff --cached --name-only; git diff --name-only; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard
